chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Khālid, from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddiq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a woman: when she performs tayammum after menstruation, does she become lawful for her husband? He said: “Yes.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.تَيَمَّمَتْ: she performed tayammum as a substitute purification

ai.seo_question: Does a woman become lawful for her husband after performing tayammum following menstruation?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a menstruating woman who performs tayammum in place of ritual purification. It states that after tayammum, she becomes lawful for her husband, indicating the legal effect of tayammum in this context.
